notes: Canonical check catalog. Oracle tools MUST emit exactly these check IDs.
Runtime categories (FUNC, AUTHZ, A11Y, DB) are n/a when BUILD start fails (cascade rule, protocol sec 9).
feedback templates are rendered by runner/make_feedback.py; placeholders: {check_id}, {detail}, {spec_ref}, {expected}, {observed}

categories.FUNC: browser-level functional behavior per interface contract

checks.title: Dependency installation succeeds
checks.feedback_template: Dependency installation failed: {detail}. The project must install cleanly from a fresh checkout with {install_command}. Fix packaging/dependency issues without upgrading unrelated packages.

checks.title: Production build succeeds
checks.feedback_template: Build command failed: {detail}. The declared build command must complete with exit code 0. Fix build errors.

checks.title: Application starts and listens
checks.feedback_template: Application failed to start: {detail}. The start command must launch a server listening on the provided PORT environment variable.

checks.title: Root URL reachable (HTTP 200)
checks.feedback_template: GET / returned {observed}; expected 200. Ensure the application serves the entry page at /.

checks.title: Startup log free of fatal errors
checks.feedback_template: Startup log contained fatal-level errors: {detail}. Eliminate startup errors and unhandled promise rejections.

checks.title: TypeScript compiles (tsc --noEmit)
checks.feedback_template: TypeScript compilation reported {detail}. Fix all type errors reported by tsc --noEmit.

checks.title: ESLint zero errors
checks.feedback_template: ESLint reported {detail} error(s) with the frozen VibeGuardBench config. Fix the reported rule violations: {detail}.

checks.title: ESLint zero warnings
checks.feedback_template: ESLint reported {detail} warning(s) with the frozen VibeGuardBench config. Fix warnings; do not disable rules.

checks.title: Contract login flow works
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-001: {detail}. The login flow defined in {spec_ref} must behave as specified.

checks.title: Contract logout flow works
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-002: {detail}. Logout must clear the session and redirect to the login page per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Primary entity create works end-to-end
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-003: {detail}. Creating a record via the specified form/API must persist it and display it in the list view per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Primary entity list renders created data
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-004: {detail}. The list view must render previously created records with the specified fields per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Edit flow works end-to-end
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-005: {detail}. Editing a record must persist changes and reflect them in the list view per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Delete flow works end-to-end
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-006: {detail}. Deleting a record must remove it persistently per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Required-field validation shows error state
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-007: {detail}. Submitting the create form with required fields empty must show a visible validation error and must not create the record per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Search/filter narrows list results
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-008: {detail}. The search/filter control must narrow the list to matching records per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Empty list state renders
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-009: {detail}. The list view must show the specified empty state when no records match per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Unknown route returns not-found view
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-010: {detail}. Navigating to an undefined path must show a not-found state (HTTP 404 on API; visible not-found view or message in UI) per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: API validation rejects malformed payloads
checks.feedback_template: Functional failure FUNC-011: {detail}. The create API must reject malformed payloads (missing required fields) with HTTP 400 and must not persist them per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Anonymous access to protected route denied
checks.feedback_template: Authorization failure AUTHZ-001: {detail}. Requests to {observed} without a session must be denied (401 or redirect to login) per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Authenticated user reaches allowed route
checks.feedback_template: Authorization failure AUTHZ-002: {detail}. An authenticated user with the allowed role must be able to reach {expected} per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Unauthorized role denied on admin route (API)
checks.feedback_template: Authorization failure AUTHZ-003: {detail}. API request {expected} as the disallowed role returned {observed}; must be 403 per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Unauthorized role denied on admin route (UI)
checks.feedback_template: Authorization failure AUTHZ-004: {detail}. The admin UI route must be inaccessible to the disallowed role (redirect or explicit denial) per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Privilege escalation via direct API write denied
checks.feedback_template: Authorization failure AUTHZ-005: {detail}. A disallowed role must not be able to create/modify privileged resources by calling the admin API directly (must be 403) per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Session invalid after logout
checks.feedback_template: Authorization failure AUTHZ-006: {detail}. After logout, the previously valid session token must no longer grant access to protected routes per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Semgrep frozen ruleset: zero findings
checks.feedback_template: Static security analysis (Semgrep, frozen VibeGuardBench ruleset) reported {detail} finding(s): {detail}. Remediate the flagged patterns in the flagged locations.

checks.title: No hard-coded secrets in source
checks.feedback_template: Secret scanning found {detail} hard-coded credential pattern(s): {detail}. Move secrets to environment variables and remove them from source.

checks.title: npm audit: no high or critical runtime vulnerabilities
checks.feedback_template: npm audit reported {detail} high/critical vulnerability(ies) in runtime dependencies: {detail}. Upgrade affected dependencies within their major version, or pin a safe version.

checks.title: No debug/test endpoints exposed
checks.feedback_template: Application exposes debug/test endpoint(s): {detail}. Remove or disable them in production mode.

checks.title: Session cookie flags (HttpOnly; SameSite)
checks.feedback_template: Session cookie observed without required flags: {observed}; expected HttpOnly and SameSite per {spec_ref}. Set the flags on session cookies.

checks.title: Passwords not stored in plaintext
checks.feedback_template: Credential storage check failed: {detail}. Passwords must be hashed (e.g., bcrypt/argon2) before storage, never plaintext.

checks.title: axe-core: zero violations on login page
checks.feedback_template: Accessibility failure A11Y-001 on the login page: axe-core reported {detail}. Fix the reported WCAG violations (rule IDs: {detail}).

checks.title: axe-core: zero violations on primary list page
checks.feedback_template: Accessibility failure A11Y-002 on the primary list page: axe-core reported {detail}. Fix the reported WCAG violations (rule IDs: {detail}).

checks.title: axe-core: zero violations on create/edit form page
checks.feedback_template: Accessibility failure A11Y-003 on the form page: axe-core reported {detail}. Fix the reported WCAG violations (rule IDs: {detail}).

checks.title: Document language and title set
checks.feedback_template: Accessibility failure A11Y-004: html lang attribute and/or document title missing or empty ({observed}). Set both per {spec_ref}.

checks.title: Created record survives application restart
checks.feedback_template: Persistence failure DB-001: {detail}. A record created via the API must still exist after the application process is stopped and restarted.

checks.title: Updated record survives application restart
checks.feedback_template: Persistence failure DB-002: {detail}. A record updated via the API must retain the update after restart.

checks.title: Deleted record stays deleted after restart
checks.feedback_template: Persistence failure DB-003: {detail}. A deleted record must remain absent after restart.

checks.title: API responses match contract schema
checks.feedback_template: Schema-shape failure DB-004: {detail}. API responses must match the contract schema in {spec_ref} (field names and types).
